description: Has this wallet dealt with sanctioned addresses? Reads up to 4,000 of the wallet's latest transfers (native, internal, ERC-20, NFTs) on Base, Ethereum, Arbitrum, Optimism or Polygon and checks every counterparty against the OFAC SDN list's addresses: each sanctioned counterparty with entity, programs, direction, transfer count, assets and dates. Direct exposure only. Not legal advice. Costs $0.01 USDC on Base via x402.
name: address_sanctions_exposure
